name: Studio Rituals
audience: women in their forties coming back to movement after a long break
promise: A strong, steady body without the bootcamp energy.
cta: Your first class is on the house. Send me the word RITUAL.
stories: I opened this studio after a back injury that took me two years to come back from.
Our oldest regular is seventy one and she holds the longest plank in the room.
We light a candle at the start of every class. People notice when we forget.
